welcome.text: I'm Lia. Pick a place in the forest. We can take a closer look together.

selected.text: Let's look beneath the canopy here.

close.text: A scan from the ground will show us the lower plants.

dense.text: There is another layer of plants below the trees. Shall we ask the field team what grows here?

open.text: Let's compare this with the other plots. The field team can tell us which plants grow here.

field.text: The team has marked three plants. Choose one to see what they found.

firstPlant.text: Your first plant is in the guide. You can open Plants to find it again.

nextPlot.text: We've checked the plants here. Let's look at another part of the forest.

mapInvite.text: You've met a few plants. Try Overhead. We can look for the same plants elsewhere.

mapSelect.text: Open Plants and choose a species. We can look for places where it may grow.

sortInvite.text: Some of the dead leaves felt dry. Put the driest observations first in your plant guide.

mapResult.text: These are possible matches. A field visit can check which plants are there.

settlement.text: People sometimes use fire to clear land. Look at the plant patches near the settlement.

keepExploring.text: You can keep visiting plots. Check the plants and compare what the team finds.

scanning.text: The ground scan is coming in.

visiting.text: The field team is checking this plot.

unavailable.text: That scan could not load. We can try again.
